title: POETS: Uncertainty-Aware LLM Optimization via Compute-Efficient Policy Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2605.07775v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Balancing exploration with exploitation is a core challenge in black-box optimization and reinforcement learning. We introduce POETS ($\textbf{Po}$licy $\textbf{E}$nsembles for $\textbf{T}$hompson $\textbf{S}$ampling), a novel framework that bridges uncertainty quantification and policy optimization. Our approach is grounded in the insight that policies trained with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization implicitly encode an underlying reward function. Building on this, POETS bypasses the complex, nested process of training an uncertainty-aware reward model and separately fitting a policy to this model. Instead, we directly train a policy ensemble to capture epistemic uncertainty by matching implicitly encoded reward functions to online, bootstrapped data. To overcome the prohibitive compute and memory constraints of ensembling Large Language Models (LLMs), POETS utilizes an efficient architecture: the ensemble shares a pre-train

translated_title: POETS：通过计算高效的策略集成实现不确定性感知的LLM优化
translated_abstract: 在黑盒优化和强化学习中，平衡探索与利用是一个核心挑战。我们提出了POETS（用于汤普森采样的策略集成，Policy Ensembles for Thompson Sampling），这是一个连接不确定性量化与策略优化的新颖框架。我们的方法基于这样一个洞察：使用Kullback-Leibler (KL)正则化训练的策略会隐式地编码潜在的奖励函数。基于这一洞察，POETS绕过了训练不确定性感知奖励模型并单独将策略拟合到该模型这一复杂且嵌套的流程。相反，我们直接训练一个策略集成，通过将隐式编码的奖励函数与在线的自举数据相匹配来捕获认知不确定性。为了克服集成大型语言模型（LLM）所带来的高昂计算与内存开销，POETS采用了一种高效的架构：该集成共享一个预训练……
tldr: POETS利用KL正则化策略会隐式编码奖励函数这一洞察，直接训练共享预训练权重的策略集成来捕获认知不确定性，从而以计算高效的方式将不确定性量化与LLM策略优化相结合，绕过了传统上需要先训练不确定性感知奖励模型再拟合策略的复杂嵌套流程。
